SunComfort Overview

Company reference — background, team, and context for Academy content

About

SunComfort Systems is an independent renewable energy and power services company serving residential and light commercial properties. Founded in 2012, the company has grown from a two-person solar installation team to a 35-employee operation.

HeadquartersElephant and Castle, London
Address241 Southwark Bridge Road, London, SE1 6FP
Service Area50-mile radius
Founded2012
Employees35
TaglineClean Energy. Reliable Power.
Customer Split70% Residential / 30% Light Commercial
Core Services
ServiceRevenue ShareNotes
Solar50%Flagship service — UK and US
Heat Pumps20%Primarily UK market
Power / Generators20%Primarily US market
General Maintenance10%Incidental on-site work

Electrical work is embedded across all services as a supporting trade, not a standalone revenue line. General Maintenance covers incidental remedial work (plastering, minor plumbing, minor electrical) completed alongside primary service visits.

Business Model
ModelShare
Service and repair40%
Installations45%
Maintenance contracts (recurring)15%
Seasonal Patterns
PeriodFocus
May–September (Peak)Solar installations, generator load testing
March–April, Oct–Nov (Moderate)Heat pump servicing, heating preparation
December–February (Quieter)Generator maintenance, indoor projects, training
Company Structure
Total staff35 employees
LeadershipManaging Director, Operations Manager, Solar Division Lead
Field Teams28 staff across Solar, Heat Pumps, Power, and General Maintenance
Office / Support7 staff covering scheduling, sales, administration, parts, and marketing
Fleet
Service vans18 (liveried, GPS-tracked)
Larger vans2 (for equipment, panels, and generator components)
StockAll vehicles stocked with common parts and tools
Certifications
MCS certification (solar and heat pump installations)
NICEIC/NAPIT registered (electrical work)
F-Gas certification (refrigerant handling for heat pumps)
BPEC/City & Guilds qualified engineers
Trustmark registered
Public liability insurance (£5M coverage)
Professional indemnity insurance
Employers' liability insurance
Which? Trusted Trader
Common Job Scenarios
Solar annual service → engineer notices roof flashing deteriorating → general maintenance job raised and scheduled
Generator maintenance (commercial) → customer asks about backup battery → power + battery storage quote raised
Heat pump survey (residential) → heat loss calculation identifies undersized radiators → radiator upgrade scoped before installation proceeds
Solar PV installation (commercial) → consumer unit too old to connect safely → variation deflected to office for electrical upgrade quote
Annual solar service → panels heavily soiled and underperforming → panel clean variation raised on site
Generator callout (commercial) → transfer switch fault discovered → defect raised, parts ordered, follow-up job scheduled
